FISHING LICENCE · FEDERATED STATES OF MICRONESIA

Federated States of Micronesia fishing licence

Foreign recreational fishing in the national exclusive economic zone requires the applicable NORMA permit. State waters have separate rules, so national vessel approval does not settle reef or lagoon access.

1Who needs a fishing licence in Federated States of Micronesia?

You need a licence

  • Operators undertaking foreign recreational fishing in the national exclusive economic zone.

2Do you need an extra stamp or permit?

  • NORMA foreign recreational fishing permitFor foreign recreational fishing covered by the national Marine Resources Act.

3Where can you get the licence?

For the offshore EEZ, ask NORMA in Palikir, Pohnpei, for a foreign recreational fishing permit (info@norma.fm). For reef and lagoon waters inside 12 miles, ask the state marine resources office.

What to confirm before the trip

Confirm the definition of foreign recreational fishing for your vessel and personal visitor permits in Chuuk, Kosrae, Pohnpei or Yap.

Do I need a fishing licence in Federated States of Micronesia?

Foreign recreational fishing in the national exclusive economic zone requires the applicable NORMA permit. State waters have separate rules, so national vessel approval does not settle reef or lagoon access.

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Federated States of Micronesia?

For the offshore EEZ, ask NORMA in Palikir, Pohnpei, for a foreign recreational fishing permit (info@norma.fm). For reef and lagoon waters inside 12 miles, ask the state marine resources office.
